mapper.update: update t_msg set msg_is_read = 1, msg_read_at = coalesce(msg_read_at, now()) where msg_receiver_id = #{userId} and msg_is_read = 0

update t_msg m join t_usr_interest i on i.int_user_id = m.msg_receiver_id and i.int_target_type = 2 set m.msg_is_read = 1, m.msg_read_at = coalesce(m.msg_read_at, now()) where i.int_id = #{interestId} and i.int_user_id = #{userId} and i.int_status = 1 and m.msg_type = 4 and m.msg_is_read = 0 and m.msg_target_url like concat('/companies/', i.int_target_id, '?positionId=%')
update t_im_session set ims_unread_b = 0 where ims_user_b_id = #{userId} and ims_unread_b > 0
mapper.select: select m.imsg_id as message_id, m.imsg_sender_id as sender_id, m.imsg_type as type, m.imsg_content as content, case when m.imsg_sender_id = #{userId} then true else false end as mine, m.imsg_created_at as created_at from t_im_message m inner join t_im_session s on s.ims_id = m.imsg_session_id where s.ims_id = #{sessionId} and s.ims_user_b_id = #{userId} and m.imsg_is_recalled = 0 order by m.imsg_created_at desc, m.imsg_id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update t_im_session set ims_last_message = left(#{content}, 200), ims_last_message_at = now(), ims_unread_a = ims_unread_a + 1, ims_unread_b = 0 where ims_id = #{sessionId} and ims_user_b_id = #{userId}
